overloads.semanticRole: RECEIVE RECORD receives a record into table from the serial port or document opened by the SET CHANNEL command.

constraints: Only works with a channel opened by SET CHANNEL; documents opened via Open document/Create document/Append document are not supported.
The record must have been sent by a matching SEND RECORD call; if the source and destination table structures differ, 4D converts values according to the destination table's field definitions.
Automatically creates a new record for aTable (or the default table); the caller must call SAVE RECORD afterward to persist it.
The complete record is transferred, including any pictures and BLOBs stored in or with it.
The read interrupts on Ctrl-Alt-Shift (Windows) / Command-Option-Shift (macOS), raising error -9994, catchable via an ON ERR CALL method.
